issues: React console warning: 'Invalid DOM property fetchpriority. Did you mean fetchPriority?' — JSX attribute must be camelCase fetchPriority for React 18+. The attribute still gets rendered on the DOM (verified fp='high' on hero img) so browser preload hint works, but the warning is noisy in console. Fix: rename fetchpriority={...} to fetchPriority={...} on the hero in pages/Dashboard.js.

action_items: Rename JSX prop `fetchpriority` -> `fetchPriority` on the hero in pages/Dashboard.js to silence the React invalid-DOM-property warning (functionally already works).
critical_code_review_comments: React JSX requires camelCase for the fetchpriority hint: fetchPriority, not fetchpriority (React logs a warning otherwise).
Sitemap.xml has no <lastmod> tags — Google will still index it but adding lastmod improves crawl signaling.

public/robots.txt sitemap URL is hardcoded to hydromind-x.com — fine for production but preview domain (aqua-intelligence-8.preview.emergentagent.com) advertises a sitemap that points elsewhere. Acceptable since production is the target.
